description: Electron-builder's msiWrapped target prompts for elevation and can fail when impersonation is enabled, based on https://github.com/electron-userland/electron-builder/issues/8219.
prompt:
I need to pick our Windows installer format for a desktop app before we send it to customers. The MSI-wrapped build pops UAC immediately and the team is debating MSI vs MSIX vs an exe installer.

Given these files, which installer technology should I use if we want a normal per-user install by default but still have a path for managed enterprise installs?
